sections.description: Practical insights into five-axis cnc commissioning and acceptance testing, from planning and implementation to measurable operational outcomes.

image.alt: Five-Axis CNC Commissioning and Acceptance Testing

cards.title: 1. Industrial requirements and vibration control
cards.description:
Five-axis machining requires a stable installation, controlled operating conditions and repeatable measurement. The commissioning plan should define the equipment requirements before installation begins.

Measurements must be recorded using calibrated instruments and compared with the agreed acceptance criteria. Any corrective work should be verified before production handover.

“Reliable commissioning connects equipment capability with a repeatable operating process.” — Kenji Takahashi, Technical Advisor

sections.title: 2. A five-stage technical handover process
sections.description: A structured sequence keeps installation, verification and operator training aligned.

cards.title: Foundation seating and levelling
cards.description: Check the foundation, lifting plan and machine levelling against the equipment installation requirements.

cards.title: Laser alignment
cards.description: Measure axis alignment, straightness and squareness using calibrated instruments.

cards.title: Kinematic compensation
cards.description: Review geometric measurements and apply approved compensation settings to the controller.

cards.title: Endurance testing
cards.description: Run the agreed test programme while monitoring temperature, vibration and machining stability.

cards.title: Operator training and handover
cards.description: Provide operating instructions, maintenance guidance and practical training for the site team.

sections.title: 3. Technical acceptance criteria
sections.description: Illustrative targets below show how an acceptance plan can document measurable requirements. Final values must be agreed for the selected equipment.

cards.title: Positioning repeatability
cards.description: Typical reference: ±0.005 mm

cards.title: Spindle runout
cards.description: Typical reference: <0.003 mm

cards.title: Continuous endurance test
cards.description: Typical reference: 24 hours

cards.title: Technical response time
cards.description: Typical reference: 24–48 working hours
cards.eyebrow: Project target: under 2 hours in the agreed service area
